caption: Police officers detain a struggling protester amid a dense crowd during a demonstration.
London, UK A stag in the mist during the annual rutting season in Richmond Park. The national nature reserve is home to more than 630 red and fallow deer.
Llanrwst, UK A Virginia creeper ( Parthenocissus quinquefolia ) is a blaze of autumnal colours at the Tu Hwnt l’r Bont tea rooms.

Lyon, France Young people hold a sign that says ‘stop budget cuts ’ during a nationwide protest by high-school students over long hours, teacher shortages and decaying facilities. Dozens of schools have been damaged and nearly 3,000 teenagers have been detained since the start of the tensions.

Strasbourg, France Students kick back teargas canisters as they carry out a blockade of the city’s university. French media reports say more than 560 schools and educational establishments have been disrupted by the unrest.

Les Brenets, Switzerland A giant ‘Help’ is written on the grass-covered bed of what was Lac des Brenets, part of the Doubs River. The river dried up in July because of a combination of factors, including geological fissures that drain water underground, below-average rainfall and repeated heatwaves.

San Blas, Mexico Waves crash along Los Cocos beach as Hurricane Rachel strengthens into a category 3 system off the country’s Pacific coast. Northern Mexico is still recovering from Hurricane Polo, with the unusually active Pacific hurricane season being attributed to El Niño.
Shexiang, China An aerial view of the land fingerprint concert held during the National Day celebrations at the ancient town in south-west Guizhou province.
Santiago, Chile A water cannon is fired towards students protesting against budget cuts to the education and welfare system proposed by José Antonio Kast, the country’s new far-right president.

Madrid, Spain Protesters gather outside the Spanish parliament calling for housing reform after the eviction of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal, who was forcibly removed from the apartment where she had lived for the last 71 years.

Seoul, South Korea Tom Cruise meets fans on the red carpet at the premiere of his movie Digger. The film by the Oscar-winning Mexican director Alejandro González Iñárritu has received mixed reviews, with some critics describing it as a ‘love it or hate it’ movie.

Ceuta, Spain A young man dives into the strait of Gibraltar. Thousands of people, most of them young Moroccan men, have been living in makeshift settlements in the autonomous city on the north African coast since a mass arrival at the end of July.

Lelystad, Netherlands A replica of the Batavia, an early 17th-century Dutch merchant ship, is transported to its new home on the grounds of Museum Batavialand. The original vessel was shipwrecked off what eventually became known as Western Australia in 1629.

Wehrheim, Germany A commuter train cuts through the morning mist towards Frankfurt. Germany plans to spend €100bn through to 2030 on modernising the rail operator Deutsche Bahn’s dilapidated infrastructure after decades of underinvestment.

Sepang, Malaysia Racing Bulls driver Arvid Lindblad in action during the free practice session for the Formula One Bahrain Grand Prix. The race is being held in Malaysia because of the conflict in the Middle East.

Durant, US Donald Trump addresses a midterm election rally for the Republican gubernatorial candidate Mike Mazzei at the Choctaw Event Center in Oklahoma. Trump’s appearance was part of a 32-day campaign blitz amid his record low approval ratings.
Mexico City, Mexico Santa Muerte devotees visit the altar on Alfarería Street in the Tepito neighbourhood of the Mexican capital to pay homage to the Niña Blanca deity.

Naucalpan, Mexico Members of the country’s national guard help its smallest recruit, Comando, to prepare for a training session. The 13-month-old chihuahua is being trained for search-and-rescue missions and to help build a friendlier image of the security force.
New York, US People arrive at the annual Diner en Blanc, a large-scale picnic that brings together foodies, culture enthusiasts and fashionistas. This year’s theme was Parisian belle époque.

New Delhi, India Police officers detain a woman during a protest demanding the resignation of the country’s chief election commissioner, Gyanesh Kumar. The demonstration was called by the gen Z-led Cockroach movement, which in July forced the education minister Dharmendra Pradhan to resign after weeks of protests calling for education reforms.
Jabal al-Armas, West Bank Israeli military personnel fire teargas as illegal settlers attack Palestinian farmers during the first day of the olive harvest.
Whitley Bay, UK The sun rises at St Mary’s lighthouse on the north-east coast. Built in the late 19th century, the now-listed lighthouse remained operational until the mid-1980s.
Cancan dancers in red and white costumes high-kick in unison above Bordeaux's Water Mirror reflecting pool in a main square with stone buildings in the background.
Delhi, India Exiled Tibetans shout slogans from a police vehicle after being detained during a protest outside the Chinese embassy on China’s National Day.

Shanghai, China A child prays outside the Sihang Warehouse battle memorial, where Chinese soldiers defended against Japanese forces in 1937 during the second Sino-Japanese war in the Battle of Shanghai.

London, UK Men leave HMP Brixton on early release. About 700 prisoners who have been serving sentences up to 19 months are to be released from jails in England and Wales in the first wave of the government’s expanded early release scheme.
Puerto Madryn, Argentina Seabirds perch on the carcass of a southern right whale.
Comondú, Mexico Utility personnel work to restore power in a flooded street in Puerto San Carlos after Hurricane Polo hit the Baja California Sur coast.
Gaza City, Palestine Mourners attend a mass funeral for Palestinians whose bodies were recovered from the rubble of a residential building hit in an Israeli strike.
Bordeaux, France Dancers attempt to break the world record for the highest number of participants in a French cancan performance, above the Mirror d’Eau reflecting pool.
Paris, France Miranda Kerr walks the catwalk in the designer Stella McCartney’s spring/summer 2027 women’s ready-to-wear collection show during Paris fashion week.
Seoul, South Korea The Estonian slackliner Jaan Roose takes part in South Korea’s first urban highline crossing event, walking a 160-metre-long line suspended 120 metres above the ground.

Lille, France A student displays a placard reading ‘Gen Z is angry’ during ongoing blockading action which is calling for the hiring of substitute teachers, increased resources, and decent learning conditions.
Gull Island, Canada Fireworks for the National Truth and Reconciliation Day burst over traditional Innu tents at the Innu Nation annual gathering in Labrador.

Helmand, Afghanistan People survey the scene of Pakistani airstrikes. Pakistan’s ministry of information confirmed strikes at two locations in Afghanistan, saying they had targeted militant camps and hideouts and killed 22 militants, and that precautions were taken to avoid civilian casualties.
Beijing, China A bride having wedding photos taken at Chaoyang Park on National Day.

London, UK The England footballer Ivan Toney leaves Westminster magistrates court, where he pleaded not guilty to assault causing actual bodily harm over an incident at a nightclub in Soho in December 2025.
Sumy, Ukraine More than 10 houses were damaged and three destroyed in Russian guided bomb strikes; two women were injured and hospitalised.

caption: Sepang, Malaysia The Mercedes F1 driver George Russell riding a scooter past Ferrari fans.
Harlingen, US The US vice-president, JD Vance, arrives to speak at a rally in Texas before the midterm elections.

West Bank, Palestine Israeli soldiers take positions during a raid in Nablus after the entry of hundreds of Israeli settlers into Joseph’s Tomb. According to the Palestinian news agency Wafa, Israeli military vehicles entered the eastern part of the city, residents were forced to evacuate homes surrounding the site, and soldiers used the houses as military posts.
Five women pose for a photo in front of a Maradona mural.
St Peter’s Square, Vatican Pope Leo arrives for the weekly general audience.
Nanjing, China A performer dressed as a mermaid at Nanjing Underwater World.

Between Wakefield and Huddersfield, UK Jamie Jones-Buchanan, right, and Kevin Sinfield, second from right, on day four of Sinfield’s 7 in 7: The Grand Finale ultramarathon from the DIY Kitchens Stadium in Wakefield to the Accu Stadium in Huddersfield.

Kilmarnock, Scotland Community campaigners demonstrate against a proposed large-scale datacentre outside the Park Hotel, where an event attended by representatives from the datacentre developer Eneus Energy was taking place.
Busan, South Korea A coastguard crew on the waterway of North Port Waterfront Park attempt to herd a trapped shark towards the open sea.
Nasser hospital, Gaza An injured child is treated after an Israeli drone strike targeted a tent sheltering displaced Palestinians in the al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis.
Paris, France A model on the Saint Laurent catwalk at Paris fashion week.

London, UK A van made to look like a heavily damaged Gaza ambulance is parked outside Palantir headquarters in Soho Square as Amnesty International UK and Just Treatment call on the government not to extend its NHS contract with the US tech company.
Kamakura, Japan The manager of the Owl Otter Cafe, which is home to rescued animals, feeds Asian small-clawed otters.
Nagoya, Japan Chung Han-jae (front) of South Korea competes against Son Man-gwang of North Korea during a round of 16 Greco-Roman wrestling match at the Asian Games.
Al-Mughayyir, West Bank Children watch Israeli security forces in the village, which is is the scene of frequent attacks due to its isolated location and the presence of several settlement outposts.
Shigatse, China Tourists admire the Dagejia Geyser as water and steam is discharged from the spring.
Srinagar, Kashmir A Kashmiri bride in traditional bridal attire and jewellery.
Naples, Italy Tourists pose for a photo at the Quartieri Spagnoli mural of Diego Maradona painted in 1990 by the local artist Mario Filardi.

Devon, UK Albus Dumblebor, Light Pig McQueen, Post Maloin and Amy Swinehouse compete in a pig race at Pennywell farm. Pennywell miniatures take part in a daily race as part of a pig enrichment programme at the farm.
Lushnjë, Albania Large numbers of dead fish float on the surface of the Kasharaj reservoir after its water level was lowered during work related to the rehabilitation of the reservoir’s main outlet.
Kyiv, Ukraine Firefighters work at the site of a Russian drone strike on a residential house.
